```{r}
#| label: setup and global-preprocessing
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)

# --- Initial setup ---
# Define colors for further use to achieve consistency
colors <- c(
  "Normal"           = "#4a4b4c",
  "Arrhythmia"       = "#d73027",
  "Normal Reference" = "#b3b4b5"
)

# Set a seed to ensure that the 'random' selections are the same every time
set.seed(20)

# --- Data Ingestion ---
# Directly reading from the compressed ZIP archive
zip_path <- "../data/mitbih_test.zip"
ecg_raw <- read_csv(unz(zip_path, "mitbih_test.csv"), col_names = FALSE)

# Assigning structured column names: 't1' through 't187' for temporal points, and 'label' for the cardiological classification
colnames(ecg_raw) <- c(paste0("t", 1:(ncol(ecg_raw) - 1)), "label")

# --- Labeling and Classification ---
ecg_tidy <- ecg_raw %>% 
  mutate(
    sample_id = row_number(),
    label_name = case_when(
      label == 0 ~ "Normal",
      label == 1 ~ "Supraventricular",
      label == 2 ~ "Ventricular",
      label == 3 ~ "Fusion",
      label == 4 ~ "Unclassified"
    ),
    color_group = ifelse(label == 0, "Normal", "Arrhythmia")
  ) 

# --- Representative Sample Selection ---
# Extracting individual prototypical beats for each class 
selected_samples_long <- ecg_tidy %>% 
  group_by(label_name) %>% 
  slice_sample(n = 1) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("t"),names_to = "time", values_to = "amplitude") %>% 
  mutate(time = as.numeric(str_remove(time, "t")))

# --- Baseline Reference Extraction ---
# Isolationg a single, representative 'Normal' heart beat to serve as a morphological baseline for comparative visualization
normal_baseline <- selected_samples_long %>% 
  filter(label_name == "Normal") %>% 
  select(time, baseline_amp = amplitude)

# --- Statistical Aggregation ---
# Calculating mean and standard deviation per time points across all classes.
# This serves as the foundation for statistical uncertainty ribbons
ecg_stats <- ecg_tidy %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("t"), names_to = "time", values_to = "amp") %>% 
  mutate(time = as.numeric(str_remove(time, "t"))) %>% 
  group_by(label_name, color_group, time) %>% 
  summarise(
    mean_amp = mean(amp, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_amp   = sd(amp, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups  = "drop"
  )

```

```{r}
#| label: fig-representative
#| fig-height: 12
#| fig-width: 9
#| message: false

# --- Local Preprocessing ---
# Join with baseline and ensure factor levels
plot_data_rep <- selected_samples_long %>% 
  filter(label_name != "Normal") %>% 
  left_join(normal_baseline, by = "time") %>% 
  mutate(label_name = factor(label_name,
                             levels = c("Supraventricular", "Ventricular", "Fusion", "Unclassified")))

# --- Plotting ---
ggplot(plot_data_rep, aes(x = time)) +
  # Background reference
  geom_line(aes(y = baseline_amp, color = "Normal Reference"), linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5) +
  # Main signal
  geom_line(aes(y = amplitude, color = color_group),
            linewidth = 0.8) +
  
  facet_wrap(~label_name, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors) +

  labs(
    title = "Representative Pathological Beat Morphology",
    subtitle = "Comparative analysis of individual arrhythmia samples against a 'Normal' reference baseline",
    x = "Time Index (t)",
    y = "Amplitude (mV)",
    color = "Clinical Category",
  ) +
  # Styling the plot
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) + 
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95", color = NA),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.spacing = unit(1, "lines")
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-ribbon-plots
#| fig-height: 10
#| fig-width: 8

# --- Plotting ---
ggplot(pathology_stats, aes(x = time)) +
  # Range of variability (ribbon)
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = mean_amp - sd_amp,
                  ymax = mean_amp + sd_amp,
                  fill = color_group),
              alpha = 0.15) +
  # Main line
  geom_line(aes(y = mean_amp, color = color_group),
            linewidth = 1) +
  
  facet_wrap(~ label_name, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors) +
  
  labs(
    title = "Analysis of Variability Among Each Arrhythmia Class",
    subtitle = "Aggreagated mean waveforms with +/-1 standard deviation confidence ribbons",
    x = "Time Index (t)",
    y = "Amplitude (mV)",
    color = "Clinical Status"
  ) +
  # Styling the plot
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) + 
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95", color = NA),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.spacing = unit(1, "lines")
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-class-distribution
#| fig-height: 8
#| fig-width: 6

# --- Local Preprocessing ---
pathology_dist <- ecg_tidy %>%
  # Exclude 'Normal' class to avoid it dominating others
  filter(label_name != "Normal") %>% 
  count(label_name, color_group) %>% 
  mutate(percent_of_pathologies = n / sum(n) * 100) %>% 
  mutate(label_name = factor(label_name, 
                             levels = c("Supraventricular", "Ventricular", "Fusion", "Unclassified")))

# --- Plotting ---
ggplot(pathology_dist, aes(x = label_name, y = n, fill = label_name)) +
  geom_col(fill = colors["Arrhythmia"], alpha = 0.8, width = 0.6) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0("n = ", n, "\n", round(percent_of_pathologies, 1), "% of anomalies")), vjust = -0.5, size = 4, fontface = "bold") +
  # Add 15% padding at the top to ensure labels don't get clipped
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15)))+
  labs(
    title = "Detailed Distribution of Arrhythmia Classes",
    subtitle = "Analysis of apthological samples only to highlight minority class imbalances",
    x = "Arrhythmia Type",
    y = "Count",
    fill = "Type"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.spacing = unit(1, "lines")
  )
```
